Urban Stay, your ideal home away from home in Yelachenahalli, Bangalore. Designed for students and working professionals, Urban Stay offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and community living in one of the city’s well-connected locations.

Our PG accommodation features well-maintained rooms with multiple sharing options, ensuring a comfortable and affordable stay. Each room is thoughtfully designed with modern amenities, including comfortable beds, ample storage, high-speed Wi-Fi, and proper ventilation to create a relaxing living environment.

At Urban Stay, we prioritize your daily needs by providing hygienic, home-style food, regular housekeeping, and 24/7 security for a safe and worry-free experience. Located close to major colleges, offices, metro stations, and essential services, commuting becomes easy and stress-free.

More than just a PG, Urban Stay is a vibrant and friendly community where residents can connect, relax, and feel at home. Whether you are new to Bangalore or looking for a better living space, Urban Stay ensures a hassle-free and enjoyable stay.

Experience comfort, convenience, and community – all under one roof at Urban Stay.
